title: Pip and the Big Bug Hotel
moral: Even the tiniest creatures need a safe home, so let's be gentle with nature.
description: Pip wants Nana Hoot's garden super-duper tidy for her party, so he sweeps every leaf and stick... until a tap-tap-tapping under an old log changes everything! Meet ladybugs, ants, bees and butterflies, and learn how many legs an insect has in this funny animated story about caring for nature, for kids aged 3 to 8.
intro: Hi friends! Welcome to Little Lantern Stories! Today's story is... Pip and the Big Bug Hotel!

narration.text: One crunchy autumn morning, Pip the little fox grabbed a big broom. Swish, swish, swish!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana's garden party is tomorrow! I'm going to make this garden super-duper tidy!
Pip wanted to sweep up every leaf, every stick... and that big, bumpy old log too!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Good morning, Pip! Can I help? I'm very, very strong!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Yes please, Tumble! Let's tidy, tidy, TIDY!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hey! Come back, leaves!
He swept them again. Swish, swish... WHOOSH! Back they came, AGAIN!
Then Tumble's trunk got tickly. Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOO! Every leaf landed right on Pip!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hee hee! I'm not a fox anymore... I'm a wibble-wobbly leaf monster!

narration.text: Next, Tumble wrapped his trunk around the big old log. Heave... ho...
But wait! Tap, tap, tap! Tiny sounds were coming from under the log!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Oopsie-trunk! The log is talking!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Stop, little ones! Let's take a peek with my magnifying glass.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ooh! Your magnifi-glass-y-thing!
And under the log there were bugs! Lots and lots of busy little bugs!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: These are insects, dears. Every insect has the very same number of legs. How many, Pip?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ooh, I know! A HUNDRED legs!
Hee hee! Not a hundred, silly Pip! Look at the big ant. How many legs can YOU count?
One, two, three, four, five, SIX! Insects have six legs. You're so smart!
Look, a ladybug is peeking out! What colour is she? Can you tell me?
Red with black spots! Well done!
And see that tiny ant? He is carrying a crumb bigger than his own head!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! He's even stronger than me!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Hee hee, that tickles! HONK!
Bees go buzz, and they visit flowers to help make sweet honey. Yummmmy!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: And that butterfly was once a wiggly caterpillar. Isn't nature wonder... zzzz... Hoo! I'm awake!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Oh no! The log, the leaves, the flowers... they're all bug homes! I almost swept them away!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Every tiny creature needs a safe, cosy home. What could we do?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I know! Let's build them a Bug Hotel! A bug-o-tel! A hotel-bug-a-roo!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ta-da! A hotel with room for everybody!
And guess who moved in? The ladybug! The ants! Even the fuzzy bee! And the old log stayed right where it was.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Welcome, little bugs! Super-duper!

Suddenly... GRRRUMBLE! Was it a bug? No! It was Tumble's tummy!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! Is it cake time now?

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Yes, dears. And thank you for being so gentle with our tiny friends.
